tool.name: create_src_repro_plan
tool.description:
Create a dedicated `/src` reproduction step contract for the current reproducer agent.
Use this instead of the generic todo tool when running a `/src` reproduction task. The created plan is private to the current agent and is intended to capture ordered, action-level reproduction steps with evidence expectations.

parameter.name: steps
parameter.description: Ordered reproduction steps. Prefer a JSON array of step objects. Each step object should include at least `title`, and may include `objective`, `suggested_action`, `required_inputs`, `expected_evidence`, `evidence_type`, and `stop_rule`. A simple bullet list is also accepted for fallback.

parameter.name: title
parameter.description: Human-readable title for the `/src` reproduction plan.

parameter.name: source_label
parameter.description: Input source label such as `inline` or the referenced report path.

parameter.name: replace
parameter.description: Replace the current plan if one already exists. Default is false.

returns.description: Returns success, plan_id, full plan object, and a status summary for all steps.

tool.name: get_src_repro_plan
tool.description: Return the current `/src` reproduction plan for this agent, including all steps and summary counts.

returns.description: Returns success, plan_id, full plan object, and summary counts.

tool.name: update_src_repro_plan_step
tool.description:
Update one or multiple `/src` reproduction steps for the current agent.
Use this to mark the current step in progress, done, blocked, or skipped, and to store the actual action taken, observation, or evidence collected.

parameter.name: notes
parameter.description: Short execution note for the step.

parameter.name: actual_action
parameter.description: The actual tool/action used while executing the step.

parameter.name: actual_observation
parameter.description: The real observation or response seen while executing the step.

parameter.name: actual_evidence
parameter.description: The concrete evidence captured for the step.

parameter.name: updates
parameter.description: JSON array of step updates, each with `step_id` and optional `status`, `notes`, `actual_action`, `actual_observation`, and `actual_evidence`.

returns.description: Returns success, updated step ids, full plan object, and summary counts.
